title: Natural affine model presentation over the original local ring
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $x\in Y$, and $U\subseteq Y$ an affine open containing $x$. Put $A=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Y)$ and $S=\mathcal O_{Y,x}$ [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], with $A\to S$ the germ map. Let $T$ be the associated-module functor [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections] followed by restriction along $U\cong\operatorname{Spec}A$. There is a family of $S$-linear equivalences $\delta_{F,M,e}:S\otimes_A M\xrightarrow{\sim}F_x$ for every sheaf of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules $F$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], every $A$-module $M$, and every model isomorphism $e:F|_U\xrightarrow{\sim}T(M)$. For morphisms $c:F\to G$ and $d:M\to N$ and model isomorphisms $e_F,e_G$ satisfying $e_G\circ(c|_U)=T(d)\circ e_F$, the identity $c_x(\delta_{F,M,e_F}(t))=\delta_{G,N,e_G}((S\otimes_A d)(t))$ holds for every $t\in S\otimes_A M$.

source.place: Lemma 17.10.5 (3); Tag 01HV, Lemma 26.5.4 (6)-(7) and functoriality; local-ring presentation part of new-e1-affine-model-stalk-tensor-transport

proof.text: Use the explicit affineModelStalkAddEquiv: inverse chart restriction-stalk isomorphism, the stalk of e.inv, then the open-restriction stalk isomorphism. The scalar-compatibility statement makes this additive equivalence A-linear.

Compose this linear equivalence with tilde.toStalk. IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv transfers the Mathlib module localization to F_x. IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_stalk and IsLocalizedModule.isBaseChange give the S-linear tensor equivalence.

Cancel eG.hom in the model square. Take stalks and compose the naturality squares of restrictStalkNatIso to obtain compatibility of the explicit transport with c and tilde.map d. The formula for stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply proves tilde.toStalk naturality. IsBaseChange.equiv_tmul proves the desired equation on pure tensors; tensor induction handles zero and addition.

proof_origin.note: Constructed the additive transport and proved localization/base change and naturality. One strictly smaller scalar-compatibility obligation remains; decomposition, net zero holes.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_model_stalk_presentation
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (x : Y) (U : Y.affineOpens) (hx : x ∈ U.1) :
    let A := (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
    let S := (Y.presheaf.stalk x : Type u)
    letI : Algebra A S := (Y.presheaf.germ U.1 x hx).hom.toAlgebra
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom
    ∃ δ : ∀ (F : Y.Modules) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A),
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).obj F ≅ T.obj M) →
        (S ⊗[A] M) ≃ₗ[S] F.presheaf.stalk x,
      ∀ (F G : Y.Modules) (M N : ModuleCat.{u} A) (c : F ⟶ G) (d : M ⟶ N)
        (eF : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).obj F ≅ T.obj M)
        (eG : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).obj G ≅ T.obj N),
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).map c ≫ eG.hom = eF.hom ≫ T.map d →
        ∀ t, c.stalkLinearMap x (δ F M eF t) =
          δ G N eG (d.hom.baseChange S t)
